article.headline: Towson wins 68-42 over UMBC
article.description: — Jaquan Womack had 17 points, five rebounds and five assists in Towson’s 68-42 win over UMBC on Saturday.
article.story: TOWSON, Md. -- — Jaquan Womack had 17 points, five rebounds and five assists in Towson’s 68-42 win over UMBC on Saturday. Zion Stanford scored nine points while shooting 4 for 13, including 0 for 4 from beyond the arc, and added seven rebounds for the Tigers (3-2). Alex Atkinson went 4 of 5 from the field to finish with eight points. Aidan Able led the Retrievers (2-3) in scoring, finishing with nine points. UMBC also got seven points from Devin Ceaser. Riley Jacobs also had six points and seven rebounds. Towson took the lead for good just more than 8 minutes into the game and the score was 36-19 at halftime, with Womack racking up 11 points. Towson outscored UMBC in the second half by nine points, with Denis Badalau scoring a team-high seven points after halftime. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
